00198 inline float clip(const float value, const float lower, const float upper) // actually ternery!
00199 {
00200     float ret = value;
00201     ret = max(lower, ret);
00202     ret = min(ret, upper);
00203     return ret;
00204 }

00214 inline float wrap(float in, float lo, float hi) 
00215 {
00216     float range;
00217     if (in >= hi) 
00218     {
00219         range = hi - lo;
00220         in -= range;
00221         if (in < hi) return in;
00222     } 
00223     else if (in < lo) 
00224     {
00225         range = hi - lo;
00226         in += range;
00227         if (in >= lo) return in;
00228     } 
00229     else return in;
00230     
00231     if (hi == lo) return lo;
00232     return in - range * std::floor((in - lo)/range); 
00233 }
00234 
00235 inline float wrap(float in, float hi) { return wrap(in, 0.f, hi); }
00236 inline float wrap2(float in, float hi) { return wrap(in, -hi, hi); }

00262 inline float fold(float in, float lo, float hi) 
00263 {
00264     float x;
00265     float c, range, range2;
00266     x = in - lo;
00267     
00268     if (in >= hi) 
00269     {
00270         in = hi + hi - in;
00271         if (in >= lo) return in;
00272     } 
00273     else if (in < lo) 
00274     {
00275         in = lo + lo - in;
00276         if (in < hi) return in;
00277     } 
00278     else return in;
00279     
00280     if (hi == lo) return lo;
00281 
00282     range = hi - lo;
00283     range2 = range + range;
00284     c = x - range2 * std::floor(x / range2);
00285     if (c>=range) c = range2 - c;
00286     return c + lo;
00287 }
